name: lb-explainer
title: How Leave By works
line: A notification when it's time to leave for your appointments
thumb_text: An alert when it's time to leave.

chapters.head: Your next departure
chapters.body: Add your appointments. Leave By counts down to the moment you need to leave.

chapters.head: How the time is worked out
chapters.body: Travel time from live traffic, plus your own buffer and a little extra for the kind of event. Then it alerts you when it's time to go.

chapters.head: Buffers by event type
chapters.body: A flight gets far more time than a coffee.

chapters.head: Back-to-back appointments
chapters.body: When one appointment follows another, the leave time is measured from the one before.

end_line: Alerts you when it's time to leave

name: sb-explainer
title: How Stopby Reminders works
line: Reminders that pop up when you arrive, not at a time

chapters.head: Save your places
chapters.body: Add a place you visit and give it a tag, like pharmacy.

chapters.head: Write the reminder
chapters.body: Pick a tag, not a time. It nudges you at every place with that tag.

chapters.head: Arrive, get reminded
chapters.body: When you get to the pharmacy, the reminder pops up.

chapters.head: All your places
chapters.body: Every saved place in one list, with its tag.

chapters.head: Stays on your phone
chapters.body: Arrival detection runs entirely on your phone.

name: wb-explainer
title: How Which Box works
line: Know what's in every box, at every storage site

chapters.head: Label every box
chapters.body: Each box gets its own QR label to print or share.

chapters.head: Move things, keep track
chapters.body: Move an item in the app and you'll always know where it went.

chapters.head: Arrive at a site
chapters.body: See what changed since your last visit, and what's flagged to collect.

chapters.head: Log what you take
chapters.body: On the way out, log what you took in a few taps.
